resolved.title: 包 Package
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Packages[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Every Go program is made up of [b]packages[/b].

A Go program starts running in the [b]main[/b] package.

This is why we need to declare our code as the [b]main[/b] package -- to make it run and create the output:[code format="go" codeId="3289"][b]package main[/b]

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
} [/code]
[note]The first line of the code defines that this is the [b]main[/b] package.[/note]

content.text:
每个Go程序都是由**包**(package)组成的。

一个Go程序的运行入口在**main**包中。

这就是为什么我们需要将代码声明在**main**包 -- 这样才能运行并输出。
content.text_html:

content.text: 代码的**第一行**`package main`声明了在**main**包中。

resolved.title: 导入 Import
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Imports[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Apart from [b]main[/b], Go has many packages that can be imported and used in the code to accomplish different tasks.

One of the most popular packages is "[b]fmt[/b]", which stands for [b]format[/b], and provides input and output functionality.

To import a package, we use the [b]import[/b] statement:[code format="go" codeId="3290"]package main

[b]import "fmt"[/b]

func main() {
  fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}[/code]
[note]You can import multiple packages at once, using parentheses. For example:
[b]import (
  "fmt"
  "math"
)[/b][/note]
resolved.description_en:

Apart from [b]main[/b], Go has many packages that can be imported and used in the code to accomplish different tasks.

One of the most popular packages is "[b]fmt[/b]", which stands for [b]format[/b], and provides input and output functionality.

To import a package, we use the [b]import[/b] statement:[code format="go" codeId="3290"]package main

content.text:
除了已知的**main**包，Go还有许多包可以被导入并在代码中使用，从而完成更复杂的任务。

最常用的包之一是**fmt**(含义为格式化)，提供输入和输出的功能。

要导入一个包，我们使用**import**语句。
content.text_html:
Apart from main, Go has many packages that can be imported and used in the code to accomplish different tasks.

One of the most popular packages is "fmt", which stands for format, and provides input and output functionality.

To import a package, we use the import statement:

除了in，Go有许多包可以被导入并在代码中使用以完成不同的任务。

最受欢迎的包之一是 "fmt"，它代表格式，并提供输入和输出功能。

要导入一个包，我们使用import语句。

content.text:
我们也可以使用括号`()`一次导入多个包。比如:
```go
import (
  "fmt"
  "math"
)
```

上面代码，导入了包**fmt** 及 **math**(用于处理数学运算的包)。
content.text_html:
You can import multiple packages at once, using parentheses. For example: import ( "fmt" "math" )

你可以一次导入多个软件包，使用括号。比如说。 import ( "fmt" "math" )
